meta.geometry: Each room is an SVG path (d attribute) of the real gallery polygon. Coordinates normalized per floor to viewBox 0 0 1000 700, uniform scale (aspect preserved). Non-rectangular rooms keep their true L-shape/trapezoid outline.
meta.empty_rooms: rooms without a "dept" key are galleries that exist in the building but have no artworks in the dataset — render faint gray.
